title: Mumbai Port A Closure
description: PORT-A terminal infrastructure has experienced an abrupt docking suspension following gantry crane hydro-power degradation and berth lane lock. 6 in-transit container vessels delayed. Vessel docking halted due to critical berth congestion.
recommendation_summary: Reroute incoming SHP-1001 & SHP-1003 to Jawaharlal Nehru Custom Port (JNPT). Saves approx. 14h dock wait time.

title: NH-48 Road Blockage near Bengaluru
description: Heavy freight corridor stalled due to landslide repair and bridge weight-gauge testing. Three multi-axle freight units carrying critical electronics components are idling 14 km ahead of the toll plaza.
recommendation_summary: Divert fleet via State Highway 17 bypass (+18 km, +35 min delay instead of prolonged +5h stall).

title: Cyclone Warning — Bay of Bengal
description: Central Meteorological Observatory has declared storm system 03B non-threatening. Coastal maritime corridors along Visakhapatnam and Chennai have resumed normal dispatch clearance. All previously rerouted tankers are adhering to normalized fuel conservation speeds.
recommendation_summary: All rerouted coastal tankers adhering to normalized speed profile. Ready to archive incident log.
